_doc: Written pitches inside an instrument's range (lo..ext) that have no fingering entry. A 'kind' entry covers every instrument of that kind at that written MIDI pitch; an 'inst' entry covers one instrument. checked = sources looked at that print no fingering for the pitch. Keep in sync with docs/fingering-gaps.md.
